page.notes: Transcribed from a scan of a 16th/17th-century Latin printed page; damaged and faint areas are marked with [?] or illegible markers. Uncertain readings: the words at the end of line 2 after "dum Romam proficiscuntur" (cannot be read reliably), the word after "temporibus" and "turbulentis", the word "adeile" (may be "adelle" or similar), the word "Blatodie" (possibly a place name, uncertain), "Rofelino", "Cal. Nouem.", "Cal. Aug.", "fe a teCal.", "Ma am", "nec militès", and the names in the final lines. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed. Marginal line numbers (10–70) and the small symbols in the right margin are printed; the symbols are not transcribed as text. The paragraph breaks could not be determined reliably, so the page is given as one paragraph continuing from the previous page. Printed "Aa 4" at the foot is a signature.
